as_told.title: Phone call from Captain White and indoctrination at first overseas PPD base
as_told.place_text: Overseas base in a warm climate

plain: Dan Sherman, a former US Air Force sergeant, says that in the early 1990s he was trained to receive messages from aliens for the National Security Agency, the US spy agency that handles communications. He says that at his first base after training, the phone in his dorm rang, and it was his first contact officer, a Captain White, who gave him the name of the next person he would report to and told him that man would be waiting at a set time with his arms folded. In one version Sherman places this base overseas in a warm climate and says he was briefed there, and he tells it as the moment a secret programme quietly passed him from one handler to the next.
